PRELIMINARY DATA AFTER 14 DAYS OF DAILY DOSING (0.1 TO 3 MG): • Rapid absorption with a mean Tmax of ~60 minutes (range 30 to 90 minutes) o Supports potential for rapid onset of efficacy • Mean effective T1/2 of ~29 hours after 14 days of dosing o No clinically meaningful change vs. SAD; supports once-daily dosing • Dose-related exposure and target engagement AEs o Potential to deliver efficacy at low clinical doses • Generally well tolerated across all doses evaluated o No serious or severe TEAEs o No liver or visual AEs; no clinically significant cardiovascular events or EKG abnormalities o Most common AE was headache (~25% of participants) • On-target AEs were mild and did not lead to discontinuation o Insomnia in <20% of participants, observed at all doses o Urinary frequency/urgency in <20% of participants, at 1 and 3 mg only Supports an Emerging Best-in-Class Profile BP-205 Development Plan 12 Harmony Biosciences | Q3 2026 Financial Results & Business Update | All rights reserved.
